info.name: Arise App API
info.description: Auth (signup/login/refresh/logout/me), School directory search, Push Notifications, Admin academic management (classes, subjects, students, teachers, announcements), and Teacher/Parent self-service.

request.description: Creates a new School and its ADMIN user in one transaction. Fails with 409 EMAIL_TAKEN if email already exists. Saves accessToken, refreshToken, schoolId, userId to collection variables.
identifier can be email or phone. schoolId is ignored/not required for ADMIN.
schoolId is REQUIRED for TEACHER/PARENT roles — get it from GET /api/schools. Returns 400 SCHOOL_ID_REQUIRED if missing, 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS if identifier/role/schoolId don't match together.
Same school-scoped rules as TEACHER login. Password here is the auto-generated default (capitalized email local-part + '@12345') returned once when the admin created this student's parent account.
Returns a new accessToken. Fails with 401 INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN if expired/revoked.
Requires Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> (inherited from collection auth). Returns the decoded JWT payload (sub, email, role, schoolId).
Revokes the given refresh token.
Public, no auth required. Returns up to 20 schools, sorted by name.
Case-insensitive partial match on school name. Public, no auth required.
Requires Authorization header (inherited). platform is optional: ANDROID | IOS | WEB. Upserts the token for the logged-in user.
Requires Authorization header (inherited). Call on logout/app uninstall.
Requires Authorization header (inherited) AND role=ADMIN (403 otherwise). Fails 503 FIREBASE_NOT_CONFIGURED if the server's Firebase service account key isn't set up.

Requires ADMIN. Creates a Class with its initial Sections in one transaction. Fails 409 CLASS_NAME_TAKEN if (schoolId, name) already exists, 409 SECTION_NAME_TAKEN if two sections in the request share a name. Saves classId/sectionId to collection variables.
Requires ADMIN. Adds a new Section to an existing class. 404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND if classId doesn't belong to this school, 409 SECTION_NAME_TAKEN if the name is already used in this class.
Requires ADMIN. Idempotent — links an existing Subject to this Class's curriculum (no error if already linked). 404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND / SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND otherwise.
Requires ADMIN. Returns all classes for the admin's school — each with its sections (+ computed student counts) and the subjects taught in it (via ClassSubject).

Requires ADMIN. classIds is optional — if given, immediately links the new subject to those classes (404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND if any don't belong to this school). Fails 409 SUBJECT_ALREADY_EXISTS if (schoolId, name) already exists. Saves subjectId to collection variables.
Requires ADMIN. Returns all subjects for the admin's school, each with the classes it's taught in. Subjects are also created implicitly the first time a teacher is added with a new subject name.

Requires ADMIN. classId/sectionId must belong to this school (404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND / SECTION_NOT_FOUND otherwise). If parentEmail is new, creates a PARENT user and returns a one-time plaintext defaultPassword — capitalized local-part of the email + '@12345'.
Same parentEmail as the previous request — the existing PARENT user is reused. Response's parentAccount.isNew will be false and defaultPassword will be omitted.
classId doesn't exist / doesn't belong to this school -> 404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND.

Requires ADMIN. search matches name/admissionNo/parentName. Enable the classId/sectionId query params to filter further. Saves the first result's id to {{studentId}} for use in Get Student Details below.
Requires ADMIN. Fetches a single student's full details by id (same shape as one item from List Students). 404 STUDENT_NOT_FOUND if the id doesn't exist or belongs to a different school.

Requires ADMIN. classId says which class this teacher teaches `subject` in — 404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND if it doesn't belong to this school. Creates a TEACHER user (password = generateDefaultPassword(email), returned once as plaintext defaultPassword), a Teacher profile, upserts the Subject by (schoolId, name), links it into the class's curriculum (ClassSubject) if not already, and records the teacher-subject-class assignment. Fails 409 EMAIL_TAKEN if the email belongs to any user at this school.

Optional field `classTeacherSectionId` (see 'Create Teacher as Class Teacher' below) makes this teacher the homeroom/Class Teacher of a section — independent of the subject/classId above.

Requires ADMIN. `classTeacherSectionId` is OPTIONAL — when provided, this teacher becomes the Class Teacher (homeroom in-charge) of that section (sets Section.classTeacherId). It is independent of `classId`/`subject` above — a teacher can be Class Teacher of one section while teaching subjects in entirely different classes.

Errors: 404 SECTION_NOT_FOUND if the section doesn't exist / belongs to another school. 409 SECTION_ALREADY_HAS_CLASS_TEACHER if that section already has a different class teacher assigned — reassignment isn't silent, you'd need to null it out first (no endpoint for that yet).

The response's `teacher.classTeacherOf` array reflects this (empty array if not a class teacher of anything). This also immediately shows up in GET /api/classes and GET /api/teacher/classes as that section's classTeacherId/classTeacherName.

Requires ADMIN. search matches name/employeeId/email. subject filters by exact subject name, classId filters to teachers assigned to that class. Saves the first result's id to {{teacherId}} for use in Get Teacher Details below.
Requires ADMIN. Fetches a single teacher's full details by id (same shape as one item from List Teachers). 404 TEACHER_NOT_FOUND if the id doesn't exist or belongs to a different school.

Requires ADMIN. `audience` defaults to ALL if omitted — valid values: ALL | TEACHER | PARENT. eventDate/publishAt/expiresAt are all optional (see 'Create Scheduled Announcement' below). Saves the created id to {{announcementId}}.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Annual Sports Day",
  "message": "Sports day will be held on the school ground.",
  "audience": "ALL",
  "eventDate": "2026-12-25",
  "publishAt": "2026-12-01T00:00:00Z",
  "expiresAt": "2026-12-26T00:00:00Z"
}

request.description:
All three date fields are optional and independent:
- eventDate: the date this announcement is ABOUT (display only, doesn't affect visibility).
- publishAt: don't show this to teachers/parents until this date/time (null = visible immediately).
- expiresAt: stop showing this after this date/time (null = never expires).
Admin's own list/get always shows it regardless of the window — only the Teacher/Parent self-service feeds (GET /api/teacher/announcements, GET /api/students/announcements) filter by publishAt/expiresAt. The response's computed `status` field (SCHEDULED/ACTIVE/EXPIRED) tells you which state it's currently in. 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if expiresAt <= publishAt.
Requires ADMIN. search matches title/message. audience filters by exact ALL|TEACHER|PARENT value.
Requires ADMIN. 404 ANNOUNCEMENT_NOT_FOUND if the id doesn't exist or belongs to a different school.

Requires ADMIN. Partial update — send only the field(s) you want to change (title/message/audience/eventDate/publishAt/expiresAt). At least one is required, 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if body is empty. If you change only one of publishAt/expiresAt, it's cross-checked against the OTHER field's existing stored value — 400 INVALID_DATE_RANGE if the merged result would have expiresAt <= publishAt.
Requires ADMIN. Hard delete — cannot be undone. 404 ANNOUNCEMENT_NOT_FOUND if already deleted or belongs to a different school.

Requires ADMIN. eventType: HOLIDAY | EXAM | MEETING | ACTIVITY | OTHER. endDate is optional — if omitted, defaults to startDate (single-day event). audience defaults to ALL (ALL|TEACHER|PARENT), same semantics as Announcements. Saves the created id to {{eventId}}.
endDate must be on or after startDate — 400 VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise.
Non-ALL audience example — same ALL|TEACHER|PARENT targeting as Announcements.

Requires ADMIN. Sorted chronologically by startDate. search matches title/description. eventType/audience filter by exact value. from/to filter to events whose [startDate, endDate] range OVERLAPS the given window (e.g. from=2026-12-01&to=2026-12-31 returns any event touching December — useful for a calendar month view).
Requires ADMIN. 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND if the id doesn't exist or belongs to a different school.

Requires ADMIN. Partial update — send only the field(s) you want to change. At least one required, 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if body is empty. If you change only startDate or only endDate, it's cross-checked against the OTHER field's existing stored value — 400 INVALID_DATE_RANGE if the merged result would be invalid.
Requires ADMIN. Hard delete — cannot be undone. 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND if already deleted or belongs to a different school.

Requires ADMIN. `classes` is required, at least one entry — each with its own maxMarks (different classes can have different maxMarks for the same exam). startDate/endDate are optional. 404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND if any classId is invalid/belongs to another school. Saves the created id to {{examId}}.
Requires ADMIN. search matches title/description.
Requires ADMIN. 404 EXAM_NOT_FOUND if the id doesn't exist or belongs to a different school.

Requires ADMIN. Updates title/description/startDate/endDate only — NOT the assigned classes (use the Classes sub-endpoints below for that). At least one field required. 400 INVALID_DATE_RANGE if the merged start/end dates would be invalid.
Requires ADMIN. Assigns an additional class to this exam. 404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND, 409 EXAM_CLASS_ALREADY_ASSIGNED if this class is already part of the exam.

item.name: List Classes for Exam (with grading progress)

request.description: Requires ADMIN. Returns each class assigned to this exam with maxMarks, total studentCount, and gradedCount (how many results have status=GRADED so far) — e.g. render as '12 / 30 graded'. This is step 2 of the flow: pick an exam, see its classes.

item.name: List Students in Exam's Class (step 3 of the flow)

request.description: Requires ADMIN. Tapping a class (from 'List Classes for Exam' above) lands here — every student in that class, each with `result` (their ExamResult for THIS exam) or `result: null` if not yet created/graded. Response also includes the class's `maxMarks` at the top level. 404 EXAM_CLASS_NOT_FOUND if classId isn't actually assigned to this exam.

Requires ADMIN. status defaults to PENDING if omitted (PENDING | GRADED | ABSENT). 404 STUDENT_NOT_FOUND, 404 EXAM_CLASS_NOT_FOUND if the student's class isn't assigned to this exam, 409 RESULT_ALREADY_EXISTS if this student already has a result for this exam (use Update instead), 400 INVALID_MARKS if marksObtained exceeds that class's maxMarks. Saves the created id to {{resultId}}.
Requires ADMIN. 404 RESULT_NOT_FOUND if the id doesn't exist or belongs to a different exam.
Requires ADMIN. Any subset of marksObtained/grade/remarks/status — at least one required. 400 INVALID_MARKS if marksObtained would exceed the class's maxMarks.
Requires ADMIN. The student reverts to result: null in the class's student list.

Requires ADMIN. 409 EXAM_CLASS_HAS_RESULTS if any student in that class already has a result recorded for this exam — delete those results first. This is a deliberate safety guard against silently losing grading data.
Requires ADMIN. Hard delete — cascades to remove ALL of this exam's class assignments AND every student's result for it. Cannot be undone.

Requires ADMIN. READ-ONLY report — no marking/editing here. date query param omitted = defaults to today. Returns EVERY class in the school (even ones with zero students or zero marked attendance that day) with present/absent/late/leave/total/percentage. NOTE: this backend currently has no attendance-MARKING endpoint anywhere (admin or teacher side) — until one exists, these counts will always be 0 in a fresh environment. Seed AttendanceRecord rows directly via Prisma to test with real data.
date format: YYYY-MM-DD. 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if malformed.

item.name: Students in Class with Attendance Status

request.description: Requires ADMIN. This is the drill-down after tapping a class in the summary above. Each item's `status` is one of PRESENT|ABSENT|LATE|LEAVE|HOLIDAY, or null if no attendance record exists yet for that student on that date ('Not marked'). Sorted by rollNo ascending. search matches name/admissionNo. 404 CLASS_NOT_FOUND if classId is invalid or belongs to another school.
Requires TEACHER role (log in via Auth > Login - TEACHER first). Returns this teacher's own profile, including every subject+class they're assigned to.
Requires TEACHER. Only name/phone are self-editable — at least one must be present. Email/subjects/salary/status are admin-managed only.

Requires TEACHER. 400 INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD if currentPassword is wrong. On success, ALL of this user's refresh tokens are revoked (including {{refreshToken}} above) — you must log in again afterward to get a fresh session. Use this to change the one-time defaultPassword the admin generated.

Requires TEACHER. Returns ONLY the classes this teacher is actually assigned to (via TeacherSubject) — never the whole school's class list like the admin endpoint. Each class's `mySubjects` shows only this teacher's own subjects in it (not the full curriculum).

Requires TEACHER. classId is REQUIRED and must be one of this teacher's own classes (from List My Classes) — otherwise 403 CLASS_NOT_ASSIGNED. Never trust a client-supplied classId for a class this teacher doesn't actually teach.

Requires TEACHER. Returns only announcements with audience=ALL or audience=TEACHER for this teacher's school — PARENT-only announcements are never included. Also excludes anything not yet published (publishAt in the future) or already expired (expiresAt in the past) — you only ever see currently-active ones here.

Requires TEACHER, and this teacher MUST be the Class Teacher of {{sectionId}} (Section.classTeacherId) — 403 NOT_CLASS_TEACHER otherwise, even if they teach a subject in that class. date optional, defaults to today. Returns every student in the section with their current status (or null = not marked) — use this to pre-fill the marking UI before submitting.

Requires TEACHER + Class Teacher of sectionId. `records` is at least 1 {studentId, status}, status one of PRESENT|ABSENT|LATE|LEAVE|HOLIDAY. This is an UPSERT — re-submitting the same student+date just overwrites the status, so the same endpoint handles both first-time marking and later correction. 404 STUDENT_NOT_IN_SECTION if any studentId doesn't belong to sectionId. 403 NOT_CLASS_TEACHER if this teacher isn't the class teacher of sectionId.

Requires TEACHER, and the student must be in a section this teacher is Class Teacher of (403 NOT_CLASS_TEACHER otherwise). from/to both optional — defaults to the last 30 days if omitted. Returns the raw records list (sorted by date ascending) PLUS a summary count (present/absent/late/leave/holiday) over that range.

Requires TEACHER + Class Teacher of the section that record belongs to. Use this to correct one specific day's record (e.g. inline-editing a row from the student history view) instead of re-submitting the whole bulk mark call. 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND, 403 NOT_CLASS_TEACHER if the record belongs to a section this teacher doesn't own.
Requires PARENT role (log in via Auth > Login - PARENT first). Returns the parent's own profile plus every child (Student) linked to them — a parent can have multiple children.

Requires PARENT. Only the parent's own name/phone are self-editable — at least one must be present. The child's student record (class, roll no, attendance...) is admin/teacher-managed, not editable here.

Requires PARENT. 400 INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD if currentPassword is wrong. On success, ALL of this user's refresh tokens are revoked — log in again afterward. Use this to change the one-time defaultPassword the admin generated when this student was added.

Requires PARENT. Returns only announcements with audience=ALL or audience=PARENT for this parent's school — TEACHER-only announcements are never included. Also excludes anything not yet published (publishAt in the future) or already expired (expiresAt in the past) — you only ever see currently-active ones here.
